title: TRY/CATCH — Robust Error Handling
description: Implement robust error handling in a stored procedure using TRY/CATCH.

data.text: Write a stored procedure that inserts a new employee and uses TRY/CATCH to handle constraint violations, returning a meaningful error message.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: ERROR_NUMBER(), ERROR_MESSAGE(), ERROR_SEVERITY(), ERROR_STATE() retrieve error details inside CATCH. THROW re-raises the error to the caller. For custom business errors (like checking salary > 0), use THROW with a custom error number (50000+) before the INSERT. RAISERROR is the older alternative.
